scope: Post-match team and player results for the attached BotStrike room
status: Automated presentation and native integration checks passed; human and physical-device acceptance remains open
baseline: The match-end menu showed a win/loss title and replay status but kept the pre-match roster; players had to open the live scoreboard to see combat stats.

observed.result: Final score, personal K/D/A and damage, both teams' ten player lines, and a combat MVP appear from the final native room snapshot during sealing and after verification.
observed.ranking: Most kills, then assists, damage, fewer deaths and lower slot settle combat MVP; no combat contribution yields no MVP.
observed.navigation: Controller focus starts on the result summary and reaches player rows; touch users can review the final panel after exiting fullscreen in portrait.
observed.verification: Pending replay sealing does not expose the signed export; a verified finish does. Interrupted and failed rooms hide the final table.

checks.unit: npm test: 73/73 passed, including MVP tie breaks, scoreless draw, result gating and portrait gate reset.
checks.native: npm run test:botstrike-native: completed 19,594 ticks at 50-33; ten final players, verified signed replay, rejected tampered result, private join, public matchmaking, reconnect and balanced teams passed.
checks.browser: tests/botstrike-post-match-browser.mjs: winner, loser, draw, sealing, verified, failed, ten rows, controller row focus across a state update, synthetic finished-room reload, result controls and no page errors passed.
checks.viewports: Browser captures and horizontal-overflow checks passed at 1920x1080, 2560x1080, 2560x1440, 3840x2160, 390x844 and 844x390; touch-enabled landscape and portrait result captures passed.
checks.hardware: Apple M4 Max; Playwright Chromium headless shell 1234 with SwiftShader software rendering.

limits: Browser final-state and reload checks use a final native-state fixture over a live local practice room; the complete native signed match is covered separately by integration tests.
No human comprehension check, physical controller or phone test, or physical-device frame pacing measurement was performed.
Individual plants, defuses and other objective contributions are not in the native player stats, so this is a combat award rather than an overall match MVP.
Full historical scoreboards are not retained in career history after leaving a room.
